payload.body_html:
{{offer_date_formatted}}

To {{salutation}} {{candidate_full_name}}
{{candidate_address}}
Email: {{candidate_email}}

Re: Offer of employment with Newtuple Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Dear {{candidate_first_name}},

Congratulations! We are pleased to offer you the position of {{designation}} with Newtuple Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (the “Company”). At all times your employment will be subject to the policies and procedures set forth in the Company’s current employment handbook, as it may be amended from time to time. On behalf of Newtuple Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (“Newtuple” or “the Company”), I am pleased to offer you an opportunity to work with us.

Start Date and Location: Your start date will be {{joining_date_formatted}}. Your base location will be {{base_location}}. You may be required to travel to or work from other locations as determined by the Company. This offer is subject to the Company’s completion of a satisfactory background search, drug screening and reference check.

Scope of Duties: You shall work for the Company on a full-time basis. During your employment, you shall not work on a full or part-time basis for any other entity or person. You shall perform such duties as may be assigned to you by the Company, including, but not limited to:

{{duties}}

In this role you will report to {{reporting_manager}}.

Compensation: Your total CTC is INR {{annual_ctc_formatted}} less of applicable statutory payroll deductions and withholdings (“Gross Compensation”). The Gross Compensation shall be payable monthly on scheduled salary pay dates as per the policy of the Company. Your salary breakup is as per the sheet in Annexure B below.

Other Benefits: You will be covered by health Insurance for Personal Accident, Medical & Hospitalisation or other as per company policy.

Return of Property and Information Transfer: Upon termination of your employment for any reason, you shall return to the Company all property or related documents, correspondence, etc. (including keys, records, notes, data, memoranda, models, software, hardware & equipment) that is in your possession or under your control.

Confidentiality: The Employee acknowledges that in the course of their employment, they may have access to confidential information of the Company and its clients, including but not limited to business plans, financial information, trade secrets, and proprietary information. The Employee agrees to maintain the confidentiality of all such information and to use it only for the benefit of the Company. The Employee shall not disclose any such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Company. The Employee shall also take reasonable precautions to protect the confidentiality of such information. This obligation of confidentiality shall continue after the termination of the Employee's employment with the Company.

Non-Solicitation: For a period of twelve months after the termination of the Employee's employment with the Company, the Employee agrees not to solicit, divert, or take away any clients of the Company. The Employee further agrees not to directly or indirectly engage in any business or employment with any clients of the Company. The Employee acknowledges that this non-solicitation clause is reasonable and necessary to protect the legitimate business interests of the Company.

Probation Period: Your employment will be on a probationary basis for the first {{probation_months}} months. During the Probation Period either you or the Company can terminate the employment relationship with {{probation_notice}} of notice.

Notice Period: Your employment with the Company can be terminated by either you or the Company, with a {{notice_period}} notice after the probation period. As stated above, during the Probation Period, either party may terminate employment with {{probation_notice}} of notice. Your employment may be terminated with or without cause. In the case of dismissal for cause, dismissal may be immediate and without notice.

This letter of appointment is based on the information furnished in your application for employment and during the interviews you had with us. If any declaration given, or information furnished by you, to the company proves to be false, or if you are found to have willfully suppressed any material information, in such cases, you will be liable to removal from services without any notice

{{joining_bonus_clause}}

We look forward to your joining the growing Newtuple family and together building a successful enterprise. Welcome!

Sincerely,

For Newtuple Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

_____________________________
{{signatory_name}}
Date: {{offer_date_formatted}}

Agreed and Accepted
{{salutation}} {{candidate_full_name}}
Signature: _____________________
Date: _____________________

Annexure B

Salary ComponentMonthly (INR)Yearly (INR)
Basic Salary{{basic_monthly}}{{basic_yearly}}
HRA{{hra_monthly}}{{hra_yearly}}
Special Allowance{{special_monthly}}{{special_yearly}}
LTA{{lta_monthly}}{{lta_yearly}}
Total{{monthly_total}}{{annual_ctc_formatted}}

Note: You will receive salary, and all other benefits forming part of your remuneration package subject to, and after, deduction of TDS, PF, ESI and professional taxes in accordance with applicable law.
